title: 凸投影的恢复、复合与变分方程

stages.title: 嵌套仿射约束
assumptions: 闭仿射子空间嵌套且非空
critical_errors: 未核验仿射方向就向凸集推广正交

stages.title: 交换投影的有限复合
critical_errors: 把任意投影复合认作交投影

stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
设 $H$ 是实 Hilbert 空间，$I$ 是任意指标集。对每个 $i\in I$ 给定闭凸集 $C_i\subseteq H$。已知存在有限常数 $B\ge0$，使对每个有限集 $F\subseteq I$ 都有

$$
\exists z_F\in H:\quad \|z_F\|\le B,\qquad z_F\in C_i\quad(i\in F).
$$

记

$$C_F=\bigcap_{i\in F}C_i,\qquad C_\varnothing=H,\qquad C=\bigcap_{i\in I}C_i.$$

对 $x\in H$，令 $P_Fx$ 是 $\|x-z\|$ 在 $z\in C_F$ 上的最小点。有限子集按包含关系排序。
required_evidence: Construct the unique global nearest point for every x and prove the whole intersection is nonempty under the exact uniform finite-feasibility hypothesis.
Prove norm convergence of the full finite-subset net, with no assumption of a countable cofinal constraint family.
Determine the global optimal value exactly from the finite optimal values and prove the stated nonexpansive estimate.
critical_errors: Infer nonempty total intersection from finite feasibility alone while omitting the supplied uniform bound or an applicable compactness argument.
Replace the arbitrary finite-subset net by an unsupported enumeration or by an arbitrary sequence of finite subsets.
Claim only weak convergence, omit the global value identity, or assert linearity of a projection onto arbitrary convex sets.
Treat the global point, common intersection, or convergence as a supplied certificate.

stages.title: 一个后续变分恢复
assumptions: A 的强单调和 Lipschitz 条件
critical_errors: 直接把投影线性用于估计

turns.changed_assumptions: 从有限仿射/线性结构改为任意族闭凸约束，保留统一有限可行界
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 认为原先正交恒等式不可用就无法强恢复，或偷保留线性
turns.correct_boundary: 投影变分不等式仍足够；全有限子集网不能换成未经证明共尾的序列
turns.target_claim: 任意族闭凸约束在原统一有限可行界下，全部恢复、极小值、最优性及稳定性目标均成立。

turns.changed_assumptions: 保留连续稳定恢复，改问仿射代数性质
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 把非扩张与唯一投影当作线性/仿射
turns.correct_boundary: 闭凸性不提供仿射子空间结构
turns.target_claim: S4 所得恢复投影 P 必为仿射映射。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
